sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Interesting! Clicking the dot at (37,18):
- The dot became magenta (M) and expanded to 2x2 (36-37, 17-18).
- The dot at (41,16) disappeared (S→B)!
- The timer decreased by 2.
So clicking a dot "activates" it (turns it magenta, the color of the second HUD square?), and another dot ((41,16)) got deleted. Hmm, or maybe the magenta square is a "piece" that moved to (37,18), and the dot at (41,16) was its original position... no wait, in level 1 the purple square started from (58-60,3-5). In level 2, maybe the piece started from (41,16) as a small dot? No, that's not right — the piece should be 3x3 or 4x4.
Another interpretation: the magenta 2x2 at (36-37,17-18) is a new piece spawned at the clicked dot. And (41,16) disappeared because... it was a "decoy"? Or the piece moved from (41,16) to (37,18)?
Wait — maybe the piece was hidden at (41,16) as a 1px dot? Unlikely.
Let me think about the HUD: S, M, p, Y squares. Maybe these are "colors to use in order": click the dots in the order S → M → p → Y? The dots are all S (sky). Clicking a dot turned it M (magenta) — the second color. Hmm.
Or: the game is "connect the dots to the ball": each clicked dot becomes a magenta marker, and the goal is to make a chain of markers that connects to the ball? The disappearance of (41,16) is strange.
Wait, maybe (41,16) disappeared because it was within the "range" of the piece's movement? In level 1, the square could jump up to 3 steps along a line. Here, maybe the piece is at (37,18) now, and dots within some radius get deleted? (41,16) is 4 rows down, 2 columns left from (37,18) — distance about 4.5. Hmm.
Or, the piece was originally at (41,16) (as a 1px S dot — the "spawn point"), and clicking (37,18) made the piece jump there (max distance about 5?), and the spawn dot got consumed.
Let me test: click another dot, e.g. (37,41) (far, distance about 23) — if the piece jumps there, then the piece can jump anywhere (no range limit, or large range). If it doesn't move, then there's a range.
Also, I should check whether the magenta thing is a "piece" or just a "marker". Let me try clicking (40,37) (distance from (37,18): 3 rows down, 19 columns right — far).
